name: Rance VI - Zeth Houkai -
source:
Sometime after Rance 5D...

Broke as ever, Rance scrambles for odd jobs to stay afloat and ends up in the Magic Kingdom of Zeth for work.

Rance is usually seen with his slave magician Sill in tow. However, in this realm of magic, the tables are turned. As a non-magician, Rance suffers from discrimination, while Sill enjoys a VIP status.

Before long, Rance winds up behind bars.

Beneath its facade of wealth and peace, Zeth is a kingdom where magicians rule with an iron fist, and those without magic face relentless oppression. Fed up with his own misfortunes, Rance joins the resistance, ready to flip the oppressive regime.

With a facade of freeing the nation's people, Rance dives into a whirlwind of an adventure: he dishes out comeuppance to wicked magicians, rallies a band of girls to join his cause, and builds a harem, all while living it up on his quest for justice...

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/rance6/s.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
《兰斯5D》的故事结束一段时间后…

兰斯仍然身无分文，只能四处承接零工勉强糊口，最后为了工作来到魔法王国赛斯。

平时，奴隶魔法师希露总是跟在兰斯身边。然而在这个魔法至上的国度里，两人的处境完全颠倒：不会魔法的兰斯饱受歧视，希露却享有贵宾待遇。

没过多久，兰斯便锒铛入狱。

赛斯表面富足和平，实则由魔法师铁腕统治，不会魔法的人遭受着无休止的压迫。兰斯受够了自己的倒霉处境，于是加入抵抗组织，准备推翻这个压迫性的政权。

他以解放国民为表面旗号，投身一场风起云涌的冒险：惩治邪恶魔法师，召集一群少女加入阵营，建立自己的后宫，同时在所谓的正义之旅中尽情享乐…

[翻译并编辑自[url=https://www.alicesoft.com/rance6/s.html]官方网站[/url]]
